query:
update transaction t
               set transfer_pair_id = case when t.id = $1 then $2 else $1 end,
                   budget_category_id = c.id,
                   category_source = 'pair'
              from budget_category c
             where t.id in ($1, $2)
               and c.user_id = $3
               and c.system_key = 'internal_transfer'
